subject: Procurement & Pricing: Redwood deployment options and commercial path
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme-retail.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 28 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap & next steps - procurement path / hosting options

Thanks again for taking the call this morning, Samantha and Tom - good conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we run this across your procurement team:

Call recap:
- Goal: pilot Redwood for search & summarization use cases across e-commerce ops; eventual enterprise rollout for catalog and customer-facing features.
- Main procurement constraints: finance prefers PO billing, need SOW + W-9, approval window ~3-5 weeks. Some lines of business will prefer a marketplace purchase.
- Technical ask: evaluate hosted API first, then size Dedicated pool; longer-term Private (VPC/on-prem) possible for regulated data.

Open questions / asks for Acme:
1) Confirm preferred initial billing method: PO (Net 30/45) vs company card for pilot?
2) Which procurement contact should we send the SOW & W-9 to? (I cc'd procurement@acme-retail.com but please confirm.)
3) Any required security questionnaire or standard RFP we should complete?

Proposed commercial path (to discuss internally):
- Short-term: Hosted API pilot (card preferred for speed) - on-demand pricing, no commit.
- Mid-term: Dedicated reserved capacity (6/12/24 month commit) purchased via PO for predictable unit economics and isolation.
- Long-term: Private deployment option for regulated workloads (license + support + one-time setup).

I attached an initial pricing matrix for reference (pricing_tiers_v2.csv) - this is illustrative and we'll align on exact tiers once we understand commit level and target qps.

Next steps (proposed):
- Samantha: confirm billing preference (PO vs card) and procurement contact (today)
- Acme procurement: if you have an RFP or security questionnaire, please send it (or confirm we should complete the attached short checklist).
- Redwood: I'll send a draft SOW + two concise commercial options (hosted-first vs direct private) for your procurement to review by EOD today.

Thanks - Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme-retail.com>

Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acme-retail.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acme-retail.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Feb 2027 10:03:14 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps - procurement path / hosting options

Hi Marissa - thanks for the summary and the clear next steps. A few answers from procurement side:

- Billing: Procurement prefers PO for anything beyond a $10k pilot. For very short pilots we can use corporate card, but PO is preferred for pilots tied to a department rollout. Net 45 is our standard for external vendors (exceptions possible with finance sign-off).
- Procurement contact: please send SOW and W-9 to procurement@acme-retail.com. I'll introduce you to our vendor onboarding contact (Angela Park) in a separate thread.
- Marketplace: some teams (marketing/ads) have procurement mandates to buy via our internal marketplace when available - that could accelerate approvals for that BU.
- Security: I'll attach our RFP extract and the questionnaire - procurement will expect a completed security questionnaire before final PO.

Can you include a 12-month committed option in your commercial summary and call out expected cost delta vs on-demand? We need to show finance the delta for budgeting.

Thanks,
Samantha

Attachments: ACME_RFP_Q1.pdf (stub)

Subject: Internal: Pricing & packaging alignment for ACME follow-up

Internal note - aligning pricing and packaging to match Acme procurement rules. This will be included in the SOW + commercial summary I send to procurement. Goal: provide two clean paths (fast pilot vs procurement-ready PO) that finance can accept.

Quick requirements from Acme: PO preferred (Net 45), marketplace preference for some BUs, security questionnaire required, procurement lead time ~3-5 weeks.

Ask from Pricing/Infra:
1) Provide committed Dedicated pricing for 12-month and 24-month tiers (assume 4x A100-equivalent reserved). Include unit monthly and total ARR, and % discount vs on-demand.
2) Provide on-demand Hosted pilot estimate (card) for a 30-day pilot at expected qps of ~2000 tokens/sec across tests (estimate monthly run-rate).
3) Confirm deployment lead times: Dedicated provisioning lead time (days) and Private (VPC/on-prem) estimated setup (weeks).
4) Technical checklist for Private: network/VPN, KMS/HSM, audit log delivery, on-prem HW spec and estimated time to deploy.

Deliverable: one-page delta table + two-option commercial path copy for SOW:
- Option A (Pilot-first): Hosted pilot (card) 30 days - then 12-month Dedicated PO commit.
- Option B (Procurement-ready): 12/24 month Dedicated PO commit now (or Private deployment for regulated data) - include platform/setup fees.

Aditya - can you and Dev turn around the pricing table and deploy lead times by EOD PST? I need to finalize the SOW before I send to procurement.

Thanks - Marissa
